layout.label: What We Do
layout.html:
What We Do

Retailers and e-commerce brands compete on the quality of the digital experiences they deliver, the intelligence of the technology powering them, and the efficiency of the operations behind them. Our AI-powered retail software solutions including e-commerce platform development, retail mobile apps, omnichannel commerce, personalization, supply chain integration, and retail analytics help brands accelerate growth, enhance customer experiences, and optimize operations across every channel.

  • We design, build, and scale custom e-commerce platforms and storefronts focused on performance, conversion, and long-term growth. Our expertise spans headless and composable commerce, Magento/Adobe Commerce, product catalogue management, search, merchandising, checkout optimisation, multi-region support, and third-party integrations. We have delivered solutions for global brands including Panasonic, Deckers (Outdoor), and Samsung, supporting high-volume traffic, complex catalogues, and demanding global operations.

    • Custom E-Commerce platform and storefront development (headless, composable, traditional)
    • Magento/Adobe Commerce build, migration, and managed optimisation
    • Multi-currency, multi-language, and multi-region E-Commerce platform architecture
    • Product catalogue management, search, merchandising, and conversion rate optimisation

  • We design and build high-performance iOS and Android retail apps that support product discovery, personalized recommendations, checkout, order tracking, and loyalty programmes. Our solutions also include in-store digital tools, mobile POS applications, and retail staff apps that connect physical and digital experiences. Built with security, accessibility, performance, and cross-device consistency in mind, our apps help retailers improve engagement and digital conversion.

    • iOS and Android retail shopping app development with personalised recommendation engines
    • In-store digital experience apps with AR product visualisation and self-checkout features
    • Mobile POS applications with payment processing, invoicing, and inventory management
    • Loyalty and rewards apps with AI-driven personalised promotions and CRM integration

  • We develop on-demand service applications that enable seamless, real-time experiences across web and mobile. Our platforms support service discovery, instant and scheduled bookings, provider onboarding, GPS-based tracking, dynamic pricing, secure payments, ratings, reviews, chat, notifications, and AI-powered recommendations. Integrated with CRM, ERP, payment, mapping, and third-party systems, our cloud-native solutions help businesses automate operations and scale service delivery across locations.

    • Multi-service marketplace with dedicated customer, service provider, and admin applications
    • Real-time booking, technician dispatch, live tracking, and appointment management
    • Secure payments, subscriptions, loyalty programs, and promotional campaign management
    • Analytics dashboards, workforce management, and enterprise system integrations (CRM, ERP, payment gateways, maps)

  • We build AI personalization engines that analyze customer behaviour, purchase history, browsing patterns, and preference data to deliver tailored recommendations, dynamic content, personalized pricing, and targeted promotions. Our customer intelligence solutions use real-time individual-level models to help retailers create personalized experiences at scale. Built around privacy-first approaches, they leverage zero-party and first-party data while supporting GDPR and CCPA requirements.

    • Real-time AI recommendation engines for product discovery and cross-sell
    • Customer segmentation, CLV modeling, and churn prediction platforms
    • Dynamic content personalization and A/B testing infrastructure
    • Zero-party and first-party data collection and personalization architecture

  • We build unified commerce platforms that connect online stores, mobile apps, physical locations, marketplaces, and social commerce into a consistent customer and operational ecosystem. Our solutions provide real-time inventory visibility and flexible fulfilment through OMS development, click-and-collect, ship-from-store, endless aisle, and in-store digital experiences. We help retailers eliminate silos and deliver seamless experiences across every channel.

    • Unified Order Management System (OMS) development and integration
    • Click-and-collect, ship-from-store, and flexible fulfilment workflow platforms
    • Marketplace integration (Amazon, eBay, Noon, Flipkart) and multi-channel listing management
    • In-store digital experience solutions: digital kiosks, endless aisle, and assisted selling tools

  • We build retail analytics platforms that turn sales, inventory, customer, and marketing data into actionable insights for faster, data-driven decisions. Our solutions cover real-time trading dashboards, demand forecasting, customer analytics, marketing attribution, and supply chain visibility, helping retailers optimize stock, reduce markdowns, improve margins, and personalize customer engagement across categories and channels.

    • Real-time retail trading dashboards and executive performance reporting
    • AI-powered demand forecasting and inventory optimisation models
    • Customer analytics, segmentation, CLV modelling, and marketing attribution platforms
    • Markdown optimisation, promotional effectiveness, and pricing intelligence analytics

  • We provide quality engineering and DevOps services that keep high-traffic retail and e-commerce platforms reliable, secure, and performant during peak trading periods. Our QA expertise covers functional, regression, performance, payment, API, cross-browser, and cross-device testing, supported by automated test suites integrated into CI/CD pipelines. We also provide containerization, cloud infrastructure management, and release governance to help retail teams deploy faster with greater confidence.

    • E-commerce functional, regression, performance, and payment flow test automation
    • Cross-browser, cross-device, and cross-region compatibility testing
    • CI/CD pipeline engineering and automated release governance for retail platforms
    • API testing and integration validation for OMS, ERP, payment, and third-party connections

  • We build and optimize payment and checkout infrastructure that creates seamless, high-converting purchase journeys across global markets. Our solutions support multiple payment methods, digital wallets, BNPL, and regional preferences while incorporating PCI-DSS compliance, tokenization, 3DS2 authentication, and ML-powered fraud detection. We also optimize checkout UX to reduce abandonment while protecting transactions from fraudulent activity.

    • Multi-payment gateway integration and digital wallet (Apple Pay, Google Pay) support
    • PCI-DSS compliant checkout architecture with tokenisation and 3DS2 authentication
    • BNPL and alternative payment method integration for global markets
    • Real-time fraud detection and prevention using ML and behavioral analytics

  • We integrate retail ERP, CRM, and POS systems to create connected operations with consistent data across sales, inventory, customers, and finance. Our services include Salesforce CRM implementation, custom ERP integration, multi-site POS connectivity, and API middleware that connects legacy systems with modern digital platforms. We also develop specialized retail solutions, including Auction Management Systems, to streamline sales, discounts, returns, customer management, and POS operations.

    • Retail ERP integration with e-commerce, OMS, CRM, and warehouse management systems
    • Salesforce CRM implementation and customization for retail customer management
    • Multi-site POS system integration with real-time sales and inventory synchronization
    • Custom Auction Management System development with returns, discounts, and customer management

layout.label: Benefits of Our Retail and E-Commerce Technology Services
layout.html:
Benefits of Our Retail and E-Commerce Technology Services

By combining retail domain expertise with enterprise engineering capabilities, we help retailers, E-Commerce brands, and marketplace operators build digital commerce ecosystems that grow revenue, improve customer experience, and deliver operational efficiency at scale.

  1. Increased Revenue and Conversion

    Our AI personalization engines, checkout optimization, and high-performance E-Commerce platforms are built specifically to improve product discovery, reduce cart abandonment, and increase conversion — delivering measurable revenue uplift from the same traffic volume through better digital experiences and smarter customer intelligence.

  2. Improved Customer Experience and Loyalty

    Through personalized recommendations, seamless omnichannel journeys, mobile-first experiences, and intelligent loyalty programs, we help retailers deliver the consistent, relevant, and rewarding experiences that build long-term customer relationships and reduce churn.

  3. Greater Operational Efficiency

    By integrating ERP, OMS, CRM, POS, and warehouse systems into unified operational platforms, we eliminate manual reconciliation, reduce errors, and give retail operations teams real-time visibility into stock, orders, fulfilment, and customer data — freeing resources to focus on growth rather than administration.

  4. Scalable Platform for Peak Trading Performance

    Our e-commerce platforms are architected and tested for peak trading events — from Black Friday and Eid to product launches and flash sales — ensuring that your digital commerce infrastructure delivers reliable performance under maximum load when revenue opportunity is greatest.

  5. Faster Time-to-Market for New Products and Features

    Our headless commerce architectures, CI/CD pipelines, and agile delivery model enable retail engineering teams to deploy new features, campaigns, and product experiences faster — reducing the dependency between frontend innovation and backend platform releases.

  6. Stronger Data Foundation and Trading Intelligence

    Our retail analytics and BI platforms give buyers, merchandisers, marketers, and executives a real-time, integrated view of trading performance, customer behaviour, and supply chain status — enabling data- driven decisions that improve margins, reduce markdowns, and optimize promotional investment.

  7. Reduced Fraud and Chargeback Risk

    Our ML-powered fraud detection and PCI-DSS compliant payment architectures protect revenue and customer data without introducing checkout friction — reducing chargebacks, return abuse, and payment fraud while maintaining the seamless purchase experience that converts customers.

  8. Trusted, Secure Retail Technology

    ISO 27001-certified security practices and CMMI Level 3 delivery processes ensure every retail platform we build is constructed to the highest standards of code quality, data security, and operational reliability — protecting customer data, payment information, and brand reputation.

layout.label: Why Choose Us for Retail Software Development
layout.html:
Why Choose Us for Retail Software Development

We are a trusted retail software development company with proven expertise in e-commerce, retail apps, AI personalization, analytics, and omnichannel platforms. Our secure, scalable, and full-stack capabilities help retailers enhance customer experiences, optimize operations, and drive measurable digital commerce growth.

Deep Retail and E-Commerce Domain Expertise

Our retail technology practice spans global consumer electronics, outdoor apparel, fashion, jewelry, and fast-moving consumer goods — with verified delivery for Samsung, Panasonic, Deckers, and Havells. We understand the operational complexity of retail at scale: high-volume catalogues, seasonal demand, multi-channel fulfilment, and the unforgiving customer experience standards of global retail brands.

AI-First Digital Commerce Capabilities

We combine AI personalization, demand forecasting, fraud detection, and customer intelligence with strong E-Commerce platform engineering — enabling retailers to build digital commerce ecosystems where technology actively drives revenue growth, not just operational continuity. Our AI capabilities are production-ready, privacy-compliant, and built for measurable business impact.

Full-Stack Retail Technology Solutions

From E-Commerce platform development and retail app engineering to QA automation, DevOps, payment integration, ERP/CRM connectivity, and retail analytics. We bring the complete retail technology stack under one roof. This breadth eliminates the integration risk that comes from managing multiple specialist vendors across a complex digital commerce architecture.

Security and Compliance by Design

Retail platforms handle payment card data, customer personal data, and high-value transaction records. Our ISO 27001-certified security practices and PCI-DSS compliance expertise ensure every platform is built to protect customer data and payment information — with security embedded from architecture through to deployment and ongoing managed operations.

Certified Delivery Quality at Enterprise Scale

Our CMMI Level 3 certification reflects a mature, repeatable delivery model with defined processes for quality management, risk management, and continuous improvement — giving retail technology leaders confidence that complex, high-stakes programs will be delivered reliably and to the highest quality standards.

Proven Global Retail Delivery Track Record

We have delivered retail and E-Commerce technology solutions for clients across India, the UAE, the UK, Australia, and North America — spanning consumer electronics, apparel, fashion, and FMCG. Our 25+ years of enterprise delivery experience and global footprint mean we bring genuine retail domain depth to every engagement, not generic software development capability.

layout.heading: Frequently asked questions
layout.intro: Find quick answers to the most commonly asked questions about our services, process, pricing, timelines, and support.

children.text: Retail software development is the process of designing, building, and integrating digital solutions that help retailers manage sales, inventory, customer experiences, and business operations across online and physical channels. These solutions include E-Commerce platforms, retail mobile applications, POS systems, inventory and order management, CRM, loyalty programs, AI-powered personalization, and omnichannel commerce platforms that improve operational efficiency, customer engagement, and revenue growth.

items.question: What retail and E-Commerce technology solutions do you provide?

children.text: We deliver end-to-end retail and e-commerce solutions, including custom e-commerce platform development, Magento/Adobe Commerce implementation, retail mobile app development, AI personalization engines, omnichannel commerce platforms, retail analytics and demand forecasting, e-commerce QA automation and DevOps, payment and checkout optimization, fraud prevention, and retail ERP/CRM/POS integration. We serve global retailers, e-commerce brands, and marketplace operators across consumer electronics, apparel, fashion, and FMCG.

items.question: Which E-Commerce platforms do you work with?

children.text: We have experience across the leading e-commerce platforms and architectures, including custom headless and composable commerce builds, Magento/Adobe Commerce, SaaS platform integrations, and open-source e-commerce solutions. We also build custom multi-vendor marketplace platforms and integrate with major retail marketplaces, including Amazon, eBay, Noon, and Flipkart. Platform selection is driven by your specific business requirements, traffic profile, and integration landscape.

items.question: How do you approach AI personalization for retail and E-Commerce?

children.text: Our AI personalization practice builds real-time recommendation engines, customer segmentation models, and dynamic content personalization systems using machine learning trained on your first-party and zero-party customer data. We design personalization architectures that are GDPR and CCPA compliant from the outset — collecting the right data through transparent, consent-based mechanisms and using it to deliver individually relevant experiences that improve conversion, basket size, and customer lifetime value.

items.question: Can you help us pass peak trading periods like Black Friday or Diwali without platform failures?

children.text: Yes. Peak trading readiness is a core part of our e-commerce engineering discipline. We conduct comprehensive load and stress testing that simulates your highest anticipated concurrent traffic, validate platform behaviour under peak conditions, and address performance bottlenecks before go-live. Our DevOps practice includes auto-scaling infrastructure, CDN optimization, and incident response playbooks specifically designed to ensure your platform performs reliably when trading opportunity is greatest.

items.question: Can you integrate our E-Commerce platform with our ERP, CRM, and warehouse management systems?

children.text: Yes. We specialize in complex retail system integration — connecting e-commerce platforms with ERP systems, Salesforce and other CRM platforms, warehouse management, inventory management, POS infrastructure, and third-party logistics providers through secure, well-tested API integration architectures. Our integration practice minimises operational disruption and ensures real-time data consistency across your entire retail technology stack.

items.question: How do you handle PCI-DSS compliance for E-Commerce payment systems?

children.text: PCI-DSS compliance is engineered into our payment and checkout architectures from the outset — covering tokenization, 3DS2 authentication, encrypted data transmission, network segmentation, access controls, and audit logging. We integrate with leading payment gateways and design checkout flows that minimize PCI scope while maximizing conversion, and we support ongoing compliance monitoring and reporting requirements.

items.question: How do you support retail and E-Commerce platforms after launch?

children.text: Operations, platform updates, QA for new feature releases, trading calendar readiness testing, and continuous optimization. We treat post-launch support as an ongoing partnership — ensuring your retail platform evolves with your business, your customers, and the technology landscape.
